4e5821484df280daf69b818820bef839c8060aff.summary: China Chopper is a web shell of about 4 kilobytes, first discovered in 2012. The article describes it as commonly used by malicious Chinese actors, including APT groups, to remotely control web servers. Reported uses include attacks on eight Australian web hosting providers, where compromised servers were connected to a Monero mining pool. In 2021, a JScript version was used by the APT group Hafnium to exploit four zero-day flaws in Microsoft Exchange Server.
